about: Questions of the kinds agents answer by hand about checks: which checks exist and where each is defined, what they cost, which overlap, which instructions call for a run. They are put to the fixture in bench/fixture/guild, a small package with a two-workflow CI, a pre-push hook, a CONTRIBUTING line and a JUnit report (the file .ask-kit-checks-root makes the kit read it as a repository of its own). Paths are relative, so run the bench from the kit's folder. Expectations were checked against the fixture's files and the scripts' output on 2026-11-21. Questions about CI run history need a repository on GitHub and are not in the bench.

questions.q: In bench/fixture/guild, which operating systems and Node versions does the test job of the ci workflow run on, and what command does it run?
In bench/fixture/guild, do two CI workflows run the same check command? Which workflows and which command?
Which git hooks does bench/fixture/guild define, and what does each run?
Which line of bench/fixture/guild/CONTRIBUTING.md tells a session to run make test, and is the same test also run elsewhere?
In bench/fixture/guild, which test was slowest in test-results/junit.xml and how long did it take?
